method: last 8 original training forecast weeks held out; all companies in a forecast week stay together
boundary_policy: previous split forecast end <= next split forecast start; Sunday endpoints have date-level granularity, not intraday availability guarantees
test_caveat: 20 exposed cases are development diagnostics; other 280 not individually inspected, but share market weeks with exposed cases. Entire historical test is not a pristine prospective holdout.
old_adapter_caveat: old Qwen adapter trained on all 1230 rows; never initialize new runs from it
unverified: historical financial filing availability and base-model pretraining contamination have not been independently audited
